substudy: Route2 Substudy 1 - Cross-Artifact Portability Stability Check

signal_families.description: Evidence bootstrap and QA gating remain operationally central

lora.evidence: Same-family T01 remains QA-clear with full behavioral evidence; near-miss substantial T02 remains evidence-constrained by weak-source severity.

loha.evidence: All three LoHa sources remain unknown_no_behavioral_eval in Ring 1 pilot; strict QA remains binding before execution claims.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: T02 policy remains source-QA dominant with weak/uncertain source counts; near-miss candidate remains evidence-constrained.

signal_families.notes: Strongly stable. Substitutions did not change the dominance of evidence and QA gates.

signal_families.description: Workflow reduces broad candidate sets to narrower actionable subsets

lora.evidence: Same-family T01 reduces 3 pairs to 2 retained; near-miss T02 reduces 4 pairs to 2 retained with explicit weak-source deprioritization.

loha.evidence: Pilot remains structurally confirmatory but behaviorally blocked under strict QA assumptions.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: T02 remains narrow-posture and source-QA constrained (10 pairs, 0 retained, near-miss queue only).

signal_families.notes: Strongly stable at workflow shape level.

signal_families.description: Same-task tends to score higher than cross-task where testable

loha.evidence: No cross-task LoHa cases in panel.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: same_task 0.8922 vs cross_task 0.4891 in perturbed checkpoint panel.

signal_families.notes: Remains visible where testable, but still limited by LoHa coverage.

signal_families.description: Same-family behaves between same-task and cross-task

lora.evidence: Perturbed LoRA values are same_family 0.314, same_task 0.2115, cross_task 0.1114; same-family remains distinct from cross-task but is not intermediate.

signal_families.notes: Panel-sensitive under local substitution. Same-family distinctness survives, but strict intermediate ordering does not hold uniformly.

signal_families.description: Near-miss / optional middle categories recur beyond LoRA

lora.evidence: Near-miss substantial is explicitly present in perturbed LoRA panel.

loha.evidence: Homogeneous same-task LoHa panel still shows no near-miss variety.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: T02 still has near-miss candidate queue only; no confirmed near-miss category in cross-artifact portability panel framing.
